title: test(plugin-security,plugin-auth,plugin-approvals): narrow the blanket pre-18 tenant-column relax rigs to the tables they write organization-less
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu9Kz1GpzqNbccvHKqWUx39Y)_

Fixes #25132

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Why `Clause-②: no`: test files only. No source, no export, no schema and no published file changes (the three packages ship `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`), so no changeset either.

## What changed

Every blanket `relaxEveryRegisteredTenantColumn(engine)` / `relaxEveryTenantColumn(engine, objects)` call in `plugin-security`, `plugin-auth` and `plugin-approvals` tests now names the tables its rig writes organization-less, through the testkit's existing `relaxTenantColumns(engine, tables)`. On this base there were 41 call sites in 38 files. The card counted 47 occurrences in 40 files on `4e2c42f363`, a count that also matched the testkits' own definitions.

- 39 sites name their tables. Most need one table (`sys_permission_set` is the common one). The widest is `catalog-reference-report` with four.
- 2 sites wrote no organization-less row at all, so their relax and its comment are gone: `controlled-by-parent-chain-middle-master.test.ts` and the `bootSharing` rig in `explain-enforce-parity.test.ts`.
- The generic comment `The organization-less rows below (global sets, positions, grants) exist only…` (and its two siblings) named row kinds most rigs do not seed. It now reads `The organization-less rows below exist only on a store built before 18.x (ADR-0131 D1 makes a fresh tenant column NOT NULL): this is that store.` Rig-specific comments are kept as they were.
- With no caller left, the blanket exports leave the three packages' `pre-18-tenant-column.testkit.ts`. `relaxTenantColumns`' doc gains one sentence on why a suite names only its own tables. `packages/qa/dogfood/test/pre-18-tenant-column.testkit.ts` keeps its own copy and callers; it is outside this card.

## How the lists were measured

The lists were measured, not read off the code. A temporary probe (never committed) wrapped the blanket form: after relaxing, it put an `AFTER INSERT` / `AFTER UPDATE` trigger on each relaxed table. The trigger fired when a row landed with `organization_id` NULL and logged the table, the test and the call site. All 38 files ran with the probe in place: plugin-security 27 files / 641 tests, plugin-auth 9 / 96 (10 skipped), plugin-approvals 2 / 18. Each site's list is the union of the tables that fired under it.

Every logged row was then traced to the test's own writes. Each row's id is either a literal in the test file, or comes from a write the test itself makes through the engine as a case's subject. Examples are "a writer with no active organization stores an organization-less row" and "the `single` posture … an emptied organization is admitted". No table on any list is there only because of an unstamped side write from production code.

## Verification (on `c4a6f34b`)

- **Sufficient:** the 38 files pass with the named lists: plugin-security 27 files / 641 tests, plugin-auth 9 / 96 (10 skipped), plugin-approvals 2 / 18.
- **Each named table is needed (the card's spot check, on every rig):** for each of the 58 named entries, that one table was dropped from its list on disk, the file was run, and the file was restored from `HEAD` (each restore checked with `git diff --quiet HEAD`). All 58 runs went red. Each one failed only on `NOT NULL constraint failed: TABLE.organization_id` for the dropped table. For the per-test `qa_parity_deal_*` objects of `bootRls`, it failed only on that family.
- Full suites: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth run test`: 94 files / 1213 tests and 187 files / 3525 tests (10 skipped), exit 0. plugin-security: see the report.
- `typecheck` for all three packages, including `check:test-typecheck`, exits 0. The test-typecheck debt ledgers are unchanged.
- The `driver-fault-auth-log-carriers` Postgres and MySQL cells skip here because their URLs are unset. Their seeds are the same code as the SQLite cell, which measured `sys_permission_set` alone.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-wxw16a`, not the repo-convention `claude/issue-25132-…` (Duplicate Fix Guard).

## Acceptance notes

- `last-admin-guard.anchor-parity` models "a tenant column NOT NULL nowhere" (a pre-18 store, or a driver that enforces no NOT NULL). It now relaxes only `sys_user_permission_set`, the grant table its organization-less row lives in. Its comment says "a grant tenant column".
